title: The Mystery Of MacBook Speakers
summary: Dave2D looks at why MacBook speakers sound so much better than those on other laptops, with input from an audio researcher. He compares them against the best Windows laptop speakers.
why: Cited as support for the common claim that MacBook speakers are far ahead of other laptops.
